title: Diamond Vault Account: Same-day transfers
summary: This document explains that Diamond Vault Accounts support same-day ACH transfers (set the same-day option during submission when available). It states interest is compounded daily and, when same-day ACH posts, the settled amount is reflected in the balance used for interest accrual. It also provides submission guidance to confirm routing/account details, use clear payment descriptions, and monitor status for posting confirmation.
